subject: Plan fusion path & concession structure discussion
messages:
From: Samantha Li <samantha@careminder.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-26T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Plan fusion path & concession ask

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for the call this morning — quick follow-up from James and me. We’re looking to move live customers off the Compact tier onto something that supports higher throughput and improved embedding latency for our realtime search pipeline. Key asks:
- Feature parity: ensure the Throughput tier + 'fast-embeds' add-on will preserve our current entitlements (session-based KV caching, prefix caching for user histories).
- Pricing impact: rough delta to our ARR if we convert the current 120k monthly token consumption into Throughput units.
- Migration help: one-time migration credit or onboarding assistance (we have an internal milestone on Oct 20).

Can you propose a path (upgrade vs. hybrid bundle) and any concessions you can offer to make the conversion clean for the customer? We’re under a procurement timeline and would appreciate clear next steps.

Attached: careminder-usage-202608.csv (usage sample).

Best,
Samantha
Head of Platform Engineering
CareMinder Health

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Samantha Li <samantha@careminder.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-26T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Plan fusion path & concession ask

Samantha — thanks for the details and the usage file. Quick summary of viable paths:

1) Direct upgrade: move all usage to Throughput tier + fast-embeds add-on. Predictable SLA and simplest rollout.
2) Fusion bundle (recommended): keep a lightweight Compact baseline for low-volume traffic and route peak paths to Throughput via routing policy. This avoids a hard cutover and preserves cost efficiency.

Concessions we can offer now: 10% one-time migration credit against the first 3 months of overage while we validate the routing rules, plus 1 week of dedicated onboarding support (technical hours) at no charge.

Approx delta: based on your CSV, we estimate an incremental $28k/mo in unit costs for Throughput capacity vs current Compact billing (ballpark — exact numbers in an attached pricing sheet). Please see attached pricing_matrix_v2.xlsx for the scenario breakdown.

If you want deeper discounting (greater than 15% effective on the upgraded portion) I’ll need approval from commercial leadership — putting Ben on cc to help with that path.

Proposed next steps: 1) Quick technical workshop (30–45m) to finalize routing policy; 2) internal signoff on migration credit; 3) draft amendment/SOW for the upgrade. Can we do the workshop Tues or Wed?

Regards,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[attachment: pricing_matrix_v2.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-26T13:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Plan fusion path & concession ask

Nice summary — a couple of commercial thoughts:

- Migration credit: 10% is reasonable as a standard play. If CareMinder signs a 12-month commit on the upgraded portion we can convert that to a 3-month bill credit instead (better for both parties).
- Deeper discount: We have flexibility up to ~18% on the upgraded run-rate if we get a binding renewal + halo terms (multi-region rollout scheduled by Q2 '27). Anything beyond that requires a VP sign-off.
- One-time onboarding: swap the free week for a fixed 40-hour PS credit (helps scoping).

Operational asks: loop in CSM for the migration window and security/compliance (they asked about KV caching controls). Priya — can you confirm whether we can offer the 3-month credit conversion and the 40-hour PS credit from the standard playbook?

Thanks,
Ben

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com; mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-27T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Plan fusion path & concession ask

Ben/Mateo — yes, a couple clarifications from finance/CS/offer ops:

1) 3-month bill credit conversion is okay if CareMinder signs a 12-month committed uplift that covers at least 60% of the forecasted incremental spend (we need the signed amendment before month-end for that to apply).
2) 40-hour PS credit is fine; we should attach standard onboarding_credit_terms.pdf to the amendment and call out deliverables.
3) For discounts: I can approve up to 15% off the incremental run-rate. For 16–18% we need a documented strategic rationale (multi-region + partner ref) and VP approval; provide the expected multiregion timeline and we’ll route.

Operational note: recommend a phased rollout — week 1 canary with 10% traffic to Throughput, week 2 expand to 50% and finalize prefix/KV cache warms. This reduces risk and protects latency SLOs. Also flagging the KV cache controls to security for a quick checklist.

Attaching onboarding_credit_terms.pdf for internal reference.

Regards,
Priya Natarajan
Head of Commercial Operations
[attachment: onboarding_credit_terms.pdf (pdf)]

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Samantha Li <samantha@careminder.com>, James Park <james.park@careminder.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-28T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps & proposed amendment draft

Samantha / James — thanks for the patience. Short summary and next steps so everyone is aligned:

- Recommended approach: Fusion bundle (keep baseline Compact + route peaks to Throughput + fast-embeds add-on). Minimizes cost while meeting latency SLAs.
- Commercial offer: 10% one-time migration credit OR convert to a 3-month bill credit if you sign a 12-month uplift on the upgraded portion (requires amendment by 2026-09-30). We’ll also include a 40-hour PS credit for onboarding.
- Discounting: We can offer up to 15% on the incremental run-rate without VP approval. If you need 16–18% let us know the multi-region commitment (Q2 '27 target) and we’ll route for approval.
- Rollout plan: 2-week phased canary (10% -> 50%) with prefix/KV cache warm and a tech workshop to finalize routing rules.

Proposed immediate actions:
1) Book a 45m technical workshop — available Tue 10/5 or Wed 10/6 (please confirm).
2) If you want the 3-month bill credit path, confirm intent so I can prepare the amendment and share the DocuSign link.
3) Sharing a test SOW & amendment link once you confirm the workshop time.

DocuSign room (test SOW draft): https://example.docusign.com/rooms/ABC123456

If that looks good I’ll circulate the amendment and loop in CSM/security for the canary window.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
